initial_assumptions: Reported in coronary artery disease patients; assumed pathogenic missense

evidence_schedule.content: VCEP rule: Allele frequency > 0.5% in any subpopulation is sufficient for BS1 (likely benign).
Patient LDL uptake assay initially flagged as reduced (60%) was performed on EBV-transformed lymphoblasts, known for high noise.
CONTRADICTION: Rigorous radiolabeled LDL uptake assay in primary fibroblasts shows 98% wild-type activity. Invalidation of damaging functional assay (PS3 retracted, BS3 assigned).
gnomAD South Asian cohort reveals allele frequency 0.014 (1.4%). Population frequency rule BS1 firmly triggered.

ground_truth.provenance: Reclassified from VUS/Pathogenic to Likely Benign by ClinGen FH panel.
